summary_md: **Geek Lite ([@QingQ77](https://x.com/QingQ77/status/2116706036404941195))** shares **termilly**, a Windows/Linux terminal that groups terminals per project, restores scrollback after restart and shows whether Claude Code is waiting or running ([termilly/termilly](https://github.com/termilly/termilly)).
